title: Spotify ramps up policy enforcement on family plans
summary: If you share Spotify sub with family, you may need to scan QR code to prove it.
llm_summary: Spotify is tightening its family‑plan rules: starting soon, members will be asked to verify they actually live at the same address by scanning a QR code that confirms their location. The move aims to curb the widespread practice of sharing a single subscription with friends or distant relatives, and users who can’t verify their residence may lose access to the plan.
